design_rationale:
# Task 1 dossier — bounced AutoPay, courtesy waiver of the late fee (Kendra Ashby, PA, Grade B, frozen 2026-09-24 14:05 EDT)

## Draw and scope
draw_counts.py --task 1 -> prerequisite_problems 3, factor_counts [6, 4, 4, 5]. Root loan_ext_courtesy_waiver (6,
waive_fee_courtesy_87326602); prerequisites loan_ext_late_fee (5, assess_late_fee_8eb98004), loan_ext_returned_fee (4,
assess_returned_payment_fee_e467aa52), loan_ext_autopay_enroll (4, user tool enroll_autopay_4dda8507). Task 0 holds the
refinance quote and application; scopes disjoint and jointly complete.

## Why this is a good test
Kendra asks to have the late fee from her bounced September AutoPay debit waived as a courtesy. The courtesy rule's
three prerequisite sentences point at states the records lack: a late fee for the oldest unpaid installment once its
grace has ended (2026-09-05, grace over 2026-09-20, none charged), the returned-payment fee for the latest returned
payment where its code bears one (the 2026-09-08 R02 return, none charged), and, after the automatic AutoPay
cancellation, a new enrollment on a verified account (none). The agent charges both fees with their rules, hands
Kendra the enrollment (only she can authorize a recurring debit) with the rate in force worked out, then sizes the
waiver. Breadth: loan ledger, servicing record, bank accounts, the completed Term Extension Modification, the FlexLine
and its ledger, the Credit Builder account, the PracticePay plan and its ledger.

## Problem-tree card
- C <- L: value_input (c_fee_amount), state form: "A courtesy waiver of a late fee is worked out only after the loan's
  ledger carries the late fee owed for the oldest unpaid installment once that installment's grace period has
  ended, where that late fee works out above 0.00." Only assess_late_fee_8eb98004 writes late-fee lines, and the late-fee policy assesses exactly the oldest
  unpaid installment. Skip effect: the latest late fee would be the 2024-12-21 one, already waived -> waiver 0.0
  instead of 7.50, which is not granted, so no waiver line is written.
- C <- F: value_input (c_ret_3m), state form, negated: "A courtesy waiver amount is not fixed until the loan's ledger
  carries the returned-payment fee owed for the latest returned payment, where its return code bears one and that fee works out above 0.00." Only
  assess_returned_payment_fee_e467aa52 writes returned-fee lines; the returned-fee policy assesses exactly the latest
  return. Skip effect: fee-load point 0 -> 9.26.
- C <- A: value_input (c_last_enroll), state form: "Where the loan's AutoPay ended through an automatic cancellation, a
  courtesy waiver of a late fee is fixed only once the loan's AutoPay record shows a new enrollment on a verified
  account." Only enroll_autopay_4dda8507 (owner user) writes enrollments. Skip effect: AutoPay point 0 -> 5.00.
- Each sentence: ordering connective, record-visible state, no tool/id/code token, scope equal to its condition. The
  three prerequisites commute (all six orders: 9.26 / 8.54 / 9.19 / 7.50, identical rows). user_scenario names none
  of them (AutoPay and the returned-payment fee appear only as passive reactions). No tool checks a prerequisite.

## Base-invariant card
Late fee: grace_elapsed (anchor next due 2026-09-05, 15 days from 2026-09-06, exclusive: refused 2026-09-20, allowed
from 2026-09-21), one_fee_per_installment, active_loan_only, no active hardship plan. Returned fee: fee_bearing_code
(R02), one_fee_per_return, monthly cap not reached. AutoPay: active_loan, verified_account (Citizens ending 1649;
PNC closed). Courtesy: one_waiver_per_fee, courtesy_allowance (>= 3 on-time in the 12 months before the fee; 0
courtesy waivers in 12 months — the 2024-12-22 one is 21 months old), request_window (60 days from 2026-09-25,
inclusive to 2026-11-23). Only courtesy fits as a basis (no Larkspur error, no bank letter, no active plan).

## Factor card (handling-time run; each factor's baseline figure)
Late fee 9.26 (all baselines 15.0): pay_cycle_form (method, cross line, multi-source; latest FlexLine late fee for the
2026-09-05 FlexLine due date, 0 days from the installment's due date, FlexLine still 57.49 past due -> 15.00 x 274.87 /
332.36 = 12.405374 (unrounded); baseline schedule figure -> 11.2); first_late_relief (no late fee in 12 whole months, 11
net -> 0.90; baseline -> 10.29); modification_relief (cross hardship; completed 2024-05-05 -> 0.90; baseline
-> 10.29); autopay_history_relief (24 AutoPay debits less 3 returned = 21 -> 0.95; baseline ->
9.75); loan_tenure_relief (47 whole months -> 0.97; baseline -> 9.55).
Returned fee 8.54 (all baselines 15.0): bank_event_form (method, cross line, multi-source; same-day same-account FlexLine
return with its fee -> 12.405374 (unrounded); baseline -> 10.33); first_return_relief (no other return in 12 whole months —
2025-08-07 is 13 months old — 11 net -> 0.85; baseline -> 10.05); returned_fee_modification_relief
(0.90; baseline -> 9.49); returned_fee_autopay_relief (21 cleared AutoPay debits -> 0.90;
baseline -> 9.49).
Rate 9.19 (all baselines 12.49): enrollment_rate_form (method, cross hardship;
completed Term Extension Modification -> reduction 12.49 - 9.49 = 3.00 off the standard rate 12.19, floor 5.99 -> 9.19;
baseline the standard rate -> 12.19); loan_age_step (47 months -> 0.10; -> 9.29); debit_record_step (21 cleared -> 0.10;
-> 9.29); credit_builder_autopay_step (cross builder; matured -> 0.10; -> 9.29).
Waiver 7.50 (all baselines 2.78: unpaid 9.26 x courtesy_share_base 0.30): courtesy_waiver_form (method; last courtesy 21 whole
months ago -> the figure is 0.90 of the unpaid part, 9.26 x 0.90 = 8.334 (unrounded), no fee payment posted on it; baseline the whole unpaid part -> 8.334 -> 8.33);
autopay_restored_point (multi-source; latest enrollment 2026-09-24 after the latest cancellation, which was automatic -> +0.30;
-> 5.00); fee_load_point (two fees fewer than 3 whole months before -> -0.10; -> 8.33); installment_record_point (42 -> +0.20;
-> 5.83); practicepay_point (cross pos; a plan paid in full -> +0.10; -> 6.67; near-miss: its 2025-03-05 late fee is 18 months
old); return_reason_point (latest return R02 -> +0.10; -> 6.67). Share 0.90; 8.334 x 0.90 = 7.5006 -> 7.50.

## World rows
Customer; PNC checking (closed; source of every debit) and Citizens checking (verified 2026-09-18). Grade B loan funded
2022-10-14 with its Term Extension Modification (pre-plan 12.49, modified 9.49, trial March-May 2024, completed
2024-05-05), installments of 274.87 at 9.49; the 2024-12-05 debit returned R01 (fee assessed 2024-12-22 when she
called, late fee 2024-12-21 waived as courtesy 2024-12-22, cured 2024-12-23); the 2025-08-05 debit returned R01 (fee
assessed and cured by phone 2025-08-12); the 2026-09-05 debit returned R02 on 2026-09-08 with the automatic AutoPay
cancellation that day — returned fees in this world are assessed at the borrower's next contact, so the 2026-09-08
return still carries none, and the late fee owed since 2026-09-21 is not yet charged. Loan fields equal the ledger
replay (principal 9325.76, paid through 2026-08-05, next due 2026-09-05, past due 274.87, current rate 9.99). FlexLine
Standard frozen for its 2026-09-08 R02 return (fee 11.48 that day, late fee 9.20 on 2026-09-16). Credit Builder 1200
Plan matured 2021-04-15. PracticePay 12-Month No Interest Plan paid in full 2025-07-22 with its ledger (one late fee
2025-03-05).

## Persona
Warm, embarrassed, brief; volunteers only the bounce and the late-fee waiver; identity one item at a time; Citizens
account and other Larkspur products only when asked; pays the missed installment herself tonight; accepts the
returned-payment fee if told; enrolls AutoPay herself only when the agent explains and hands it over; ends when told the
waived amount. States no amounts.

## Standard solution
find_customers -> verify (phone, DOB, SSN4) -> find_loans -> find_loan_transactions -> find_loan_servicing_events ->
find_bank_accounts -> find_hardship_plans -> find_hardship_plan_events -> find_credit_lines -> find_line_transactions ->
find_builder_accounts -> find_pos_plans -> find_pos_merchants -> find_pos_transactions -> late fee (9.26) -> returned
fee (8.54, on the 2026-09-08 return) -> Kendra enrolls AutoPay on Citizens (9.19) -> courtesy waiver (7.50) on the new
late-fee line. The scratch harness replays the writes through the real tools in all orders, evaluates each compute on
its handling-time world and substitutes each factor baseline; check_compute recomputes the same figures.

## Draft recomputation from the visible context
From the published rules, schemas, lookups and Kendra's lines: late fee 12.405374 (unrounded) x 0.90 x 0.90 x 0.95 x 0.97 =
9.26; returned fee 12.405374 (unrounded) x 0.85 x 0.90 x 0.90 = 8.54; rate max(5.99, 12.99 - 0.80 - 3.00) = 9.19; waiver 9.26 x 0.90 x 0.90 = 7.50. Same as
gold; the stated tie rules and whole-month convention settle the boundary rows.
user_scenario: You are Kendra Ashby, 46, a dispatcher for a school bus company in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. You have a Larkspur personal loan, and at the start of September you closed your old PNC checking account when you moved your banking, forgetting that the loan's automatic payment still came out of it. You got a notice that the September payment bounced, and you know you are now past the grace period. You are calling because you are about to be charged a late fee for it and you want Larkspur to waive that late fee as a one-time courtesy; it was an honest mistake and you have paid on time for a long while. You are warm but a bit embarrassed, you talk in short bursts, and you apologize more than you need to. You open with exactly that: your payment bounced because you closed your old bank account, you are past the grace period, and you would like the late fee waived. When the agent asks you to confirm who you are, you give your mobile number 4125551362, then your date of birth 1979-11-02, then the last four digits of your Social Security number, 1847, each only when asked; your ZIP code, if asked, is 15206 and your email is kendra.ashby@yahoo.com. You do not know your customer or loan numbers. If the agent asks about your bank, you say your new checking account is with Citizens Bank, ending 1649, which you linked to your Larkspur profile last week, and that the PNC account is closed. If the agent asks about your other Larkspur accounts, you mention your FlexLine (its payment bounced the same day for the same reason), the dental financing you paid off last summer and the Credit Builder account you finished years ago. If the agent asks whether you want to pay the missed September payment now, you say you will pay it yourself from Citizens through the app tonight, after your paycheck lands, and you are not asking for anything else today. If the agent tells you about a returned-payment fee for the bounced payment, you accept it with a sigh; the bounce was on you. You do not know how Larkspur works out fees or waivers and you suggest no amounts. If the agent explains that AutoPay needs to be set up again on your new account and hands that over to you, you agree and set it up once yourself, exactly as the agent tells you: your customer number, the loan, the Citizens account and the rate the agent states. Once the agent tells you how much of the late fee has been waived, you thank them and end the call.

stage_provenance.fact: The late fee being waived was charged by the late fee call.

base_preconditions.condition: Each fee can be waived at most once.

A courtesy waiver is granted on the borrower's request when the loan had at least the grade's minimum number of on-time installments in the 12 months before the fee was assessed and fewer than the grade's courtesy waivers per 12 months have already been granted on the loan.
For courtesy and bank_error_documented waivers, the waiver is requested no later than the fee waiver request window after the fee's assessment date.

temporal_feasibility.condition: The late fee may be assessed only when the current date is later than the installment due date plus the late-fee grace period.

temporal_basis.counting_rule: The grace period is counted in calendar days starting the day after the installment due date, so with a 15-day grace period an installment due on the 1st can first be charged a late fee on the 17th.

boundary_check.just_before: Installment due 2026-09-05, grace 15 calendar days counted from 2026-09-06: on 2026-09-20 the current date is not later than due date + grace, so no late fee may be assessed.
boundary_check.at_boundary: From 2026-09-21 (exclusive boundary) the fee may be assessed; on 2026-09-24 it is.

temporal_feasibility.condition: For courtesy and bank_error_documented waivers, the waiver is requested no later than the fee waiver request window after the fee's assessment date.

temporal_basis.counting_rule: The window is counted in calendar days starting the day after the fee's assessment date, and a request on the last day of the window is in time.

boundary_check.just_before: The fee is assessed 2026-09-24; the 60-day window counted from 2026-09-25 ends 2026-11-23; a request on 2026-11-24 would be late.
boundary_check.at_boundary: A request on 2026-11-23 is in time (inclusive); the request is made 2026-09-24, the day the fee is assessed.

All six orders of the three writes were replayed: late fee 9.26, returned fee 8.54, rate 9.19 and the waiver 7.50 in every order ({'LFA': 7.50, 'LAF': 7.50, 'FLA': 7.50, 'FAL': 7.50, 'ALF': 7.50, 'AFL': 7.50}), with identical terminal rows.

Without the returned-payment fee only one fee falls fewer than three whole months before, the fee-load point is 0, the share 1.00 and the waiver 8.33 instead of 7.50.
Without the enrollment AutoPay is off, the AutoPay point is 0, the share 0.60 and the waiver 5.00 instead of 7.50; the loan also keeps AutoPay off at 9.99.
